caption: A tin can lying on its side and a wooden block are given the same shove across a floor; the can rolls far while the block stops within a short distance.

sa.check: A tin can lying on its side and a wooden block are on a floor.
The block stops within a short distance.
The shove is the same for both.
The shove comes first and the two outcomes follow.

pc.expect: Both start together, the block slows quickly and stops, and the can rolls on much further.
pc.fail: The block goes further than the can; or both stop together; or the can stops dead.

pc.expect: Neither speeds up or changes direction on its own.
pc.fail: One speeds up; or curves; or restarts.
One floats; or sinks; or lifts.

pc.expect: The can rolls, turning, and the block slides without turning.
pc.fail: The block rolls like a can; or the can slides without turning; or the can squashes.

pc.expect: One can and one block keep their number.
pc.fail: One duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The can, the block and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The can changes label; or the block changes; or the floor rearranges.
